name: sup-run-prevcomp-first
notes: Additivity of `vdelta run`'s 2-stage default baseline resolution (issue #72): even though a wide run (`W`, selector `[]`) exists in the store and would be a valid `previous-superset` candidate, stage 1 (`previous-comparable`) resolves first against the narrower same-stream run `A` (selector `['src']`), so stage 2 is never reached. `B`'s automatic report proves this by carrying `baseline.mode: 'previous-comparable'` (not `'previous-superset'`) and by pointing `baseline.run_id` at `A`'s `current.run_id`, not `W`'s. A marker commit between `A` and `B` keeps the two runs content-distinct so the store does not dedupe them to a single run_id (§3.5).

steps.message: advance tree before B (keep A and B content-distinct)
